name: Tile-Based Neural Material Classification and Sorting
aliases: ClassificationA, ClassificationB, Mixed Tile Repacking, Tile-based Neural Material Classification and Sorting
Tile-based Neural Material Classification and Sorting
definition: A two-pass compute shader pipeline that classifies 8x4 pixel tiles based on the neural material (MLP) index used by their pixels, separating them into uniform tiles (single MLP) and mixed tiles (multiple MLPs), then sorts mixed tiles to ensure uniform MLP usage per tile for efficient hardware matrix multiplication.
summary: Tile-Based Neural Material Classification and Sorting is a two-pass compute shader pipeline that classifies and sorts pixel tiles by material index to ensure uniform MLP usage, eliminating thread divergence in cooperative vector matrix multiplication.
